title: 1980s spinning gyroscope mass loss papers
summary: Dave Rossi tells of 1980s spinning gyroscope mass loss papers, about 1980s at magnetically shielded laboratories, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: privately once the late 1970s hit there are some papers still that came out in the 80s dealing with spinning gyroscopes with certain electrical and uh, other components applied to them where the spinning gyroscope would lose its, uh, would lose some of its mass.

plain: A researcher named Dave Rossi says that after the late 1970s this kind of work went private, but some scientific papers still came out in the 1980s about spinning gyroscopes with electrical parts attached. According to Rossi, these papers, done in labs shielded from magnetism, reported that the spinning gyroscope lost some of its mass. If true, it would point to a way of weakening the pull of gravity.
